decision.reasoning_trace: The product feed contains a lot of specialty items such as cooler bags, hydration packs, and disc golf bags, along with general accessories. For a general-purpose backpack session, I narrowed the selection down to the most reputable options with solid ratings. The Osprey Exos 58 is a premium choice but very expensive and perhaps too specialized for everyday use. The TOURIT and N NEVO RHINO bags have some concerning reviews regarding durability and leaks. The adidas Hermosa Mesh Backpack stands out as the most reliable brand-name option with high ratings (4.7) and a reasonable price point, making it the best overall choice despite being a mesh design.
